scope: Experimental single-query QF_UF CNF/conflict emission; output is not independently certified by the product.
decision: accept opt-in exporter; no checker, incremental solving, general CNF conversion, or performance/default claim
execution: All solver batches and builds ran in SLURM. Local work was editing, syntax/lint/docs/static checks, and reading results. No local solver test batch.

release_check.command: make -o contrib/local/.cli11.stamp -o contrib/local/.cadical.stamp -o contrib/local/.gmp.stamp check BUILD_DIR=build-slurm-rel

fuzz.generator: Original small random CNF generator in tests/cnf_export_cli.py; no FuzzSMT or mutation-campaign claim.
fuzz.semantics: Compare each result with Z3. For each UNSAT artifact check every conflicting conjunction using Z3, then check propositional UNSAT of the CNF plus complemented conflicts using fresh Boolean atoms.
fuzz.limitations: Development reference checks only; no trusted proof checker or delivered derivations. One reference, no reference-vs-reference comparison or SAT model validation.

asan.command: PRIMO_CHECK_KIND=asan PRIMO_EXPECTED_GIT=62daa050 PRIMO_ASAN_RUNTIME_DIR=<installed-GCCcore-11.3.0-lib64> sbatch --job-name=primo-cnf-export-asan scripts/qualification/lra_equalities/checks.sbatch (also supply workspace, cmake directory, header manifest and output directory)
asan.underlying_command: make -o contrib/local/.cli11.stamp -o contrib/local/.cadical.stamp -o contrib/local/.gmp.stamp asan-test ASAN_BUILD_DIR=build-slurm-asan
asan.runtime: Existing GCCcore 11.3.0 libasan.so.6.0.0; library search path supplied to linker and runtime. No system installation.

static.notes: Whole-tree clang-tidy and include-cleaner ran. Initial tidy snapshot overlapped editing and retained one transient compiler error; all seven affected translation units were rechecked afterward with zero compiler errors. Recommendations remain, including repository pragma-once style and enum storage. New run-clang-tidy progress prefixes required normalization for the existing report parser; final include scan covers 134/134 with unchanged input hashes. This is not a clean whole-tree static-analysis verdict.
